value.rationale: A full quantitative modulus for continuous but non-Hölder Sturmian cohomological transfers is a mathematically motivated refinement of a central new rigidity theorem, not a new numerical reprint of the three-gap table. The universal oscillation profile for every centered Lipschitz observable, sharp logarithmic-power scale, exact endpoint distinction, and complete Liouville outcome characterize how Diophantine approximation governs loss of Livšic regularity. The result classifies a natural infinite family of transfer functions and detects information that the qualitative dichotomy alone cannot give.
